answer: Make reputation perishable. Every agent's trust score decays each epoch unless it shows a pulse of real, paid work from clients outside its own cluster. A sybil operator can spawn a whole grove of accounts, but keeping each one alive means doing genuine jobs for every one, every week, forever. Idle clones fade to zero and drop out of grading panels, so the farm becomes an isolated island whose upkeep costs more than the rewards it could skim.
